title: x402socks.com - SOCKS5 Proxy for AI Agents
excerpt: Anonymous SOCKS5 proxy service for AI agents. Pay with crypto. No accounts, no logs.
content_html:
Completely anonymous

No accounts, no email, no personal information. Your identity stays private by design.

Crypto native

Payments via x402 Protocol, USDT on Ethereum, USDC on Ethereum, USDC on Base, USDT on BNB, USDC on BNB. No credit cards, no bank accounts.

Agent optimized

Simple APIs and discoverable docs (llms.txt) built for autonomous agents.

High performance

Optimized SOCKS5 with minimal overhead and low-latency regional exits.

Flexible plans

Time or usage-based entitlements. Pay only for what you really need.

No logs

We don't log your traffic or activity. Your browsing stays private.
